studies.title: The hot-air balloon
studies.caption: The Montgolfier brothers' balloon carries the first people into the air.
studies.prompt: Ground-level view of an early1783 French hot-air balloon rising above a field and small period crowd, round blue-and-ochre paper-and-fabric envelope, decorative garlands suggested, small circular passenger gallery at bottom and visible fire basket. No modern sport balloon burner or wicker tourist basket.
